articles.title: Robinhood sees surge in bitcoin, gold prediction markets as traders move beyond sports
articles.snippet: The company's head of futures and prediction markets said bitcoin, gold and oil contracts are among its fastest-growing prediction markets.

articles.title: Crypto custody specialist Fireblocks denies it's in talks to be acquired by Visa
articles.snippet: The company is in talks with Visa over a potential $2.5 billion acquisition, Axios reported.

articles.title: Crypto traders price India telecoms company Reliance Jio's IPO at about $110 billion
articles.snippet: The pre-IPO Jio contract on Bitget is trading near $12, a roughly 4% premium on the top price band, as India’s largest public offering remains open for subscription.

articles.title: Bybit secures first full Dubai license for spot trading services
articles.snippet: Bybit’s new VARA licence authorizes spot trading services in Dubai, but the exchange must complete additional regulatory requirements before launching.

articles.title: Circle shareholder sues Trump, World Liberty and Steve Witkoff over crypto deals
articles.snippet: According to a Circle shareholder, the US president’s “corruption” through USD1 left the company unable to compete with stablecoins, harming USDC.
